items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Pres would wind up and do all this with the ball and rub it down... Pres threw a pitch, and they would lose the ball. Everybody would die laughing.

ctx.x: You mean, they couldn’t play baseball.

Not really. Pres was a pitcher. Pres was something else anyway. He called everybody else Presarini. So he would pitch. He used to knock us out, because Pres would wind up and do all this with the ball and rub it down. “Ah, now Presarini is going to throw his fastball. Nobody possibly is going to hit Pres.” Pres threw a pitch, and they would lose the ball. Everybody would die laughing. Because they hit Pres’s ball. That’s the hardest hit ball I’ve ever seen, and Pres is supposed to be this great pitcher. Aw man,…
How old were you when you used to – you used to go to all these baseball games and stuff?
